record.question: Who fought against Babur in the First Battle of Panipat?
record.explanation: Answer D: Ibrahim Lodi. Ibrahim Lodi led the Delhi Sultanate forces against Babur at Panipat in 1526. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/event/First-Battle-of-Panipat. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
